field_notes.basis_spread: Identifier values are stated as percentages, for example S + 6.25%.
field_notes.interest_rate: Identifier values are stated as percentages, for example Interest Rate 9.77%.
field_notes.pik_rate: PIK is optional and appears inside '(incl. X% PIK)' in the debt identifiers sampled for this signature.
field_notes.maturity_date: Debt identifiers state Maturity Date in M/D/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY form.
field_notes.old_era_investment_rows: Older INVESTMENT samples may have rate twins, but the identifier strings only carry issuer and tranche/index; those rates are not identifier-embedded datapoints.

coupon_type.fixed_when: reference_rate_type absent and basis_spread or pik_rate present

evidence: Bundle dominant DEBT INVESTMENT INVESTMENT samples across 2025-09-30, 2025-12-31, and 2026-03-31 embed Reference Rate and Spread S + spread, optional incl. PIK, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date.
Bundle DEBT INVESTMENT samples use the same embedded debt rate/date format as DEBT INVESTMENT INVESTMENT, including S + spread, incl. PIK, Interest Rate, and Maturity Date.

Bundle older INVESTMENT samples across 2023-03-31 through 2025-06-30 carry issuer-only or issuer-plus-tranche identifiers such as Associations, Inc. 1 and Firebird Acquisition Corp, Inc. 1 even when structured twins have rates, so those source-column rates are not used as identifier grammar fields.
